C1368.title: Poly Network Cross-Chain Bridge Attack
C1368.summary: The Poly Network cross-chain bridge was exploited due to an on-chain contract vulnerability, resulting in a loss of approximately $600 million, making it one of the largest security incidents in DeFi history. The attacker leveraged a contract flaw to mint tokens on the target chain without locking assets on the source chain.
